purpose: A tappable card that is all picture or video, with its title on a ground that travels with the text, for showcases and feeds.

props.title: string
props.label: string, optional, spoken after the title

accessibility: One VoiceOver button reading the title and the label; the media is hidden. At accessibility text sizes the title moves under the media so it can grow and is never cut off. The ground reaches 4.5:1 over any picture.
name: MediaCard
